dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 29, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Upsets and Dominant Performances**

The Miami Marlins took down the Philadelphia Phillies 8-6, led by Griffin Conine's 9th home run of the season. Conine's two-run homer in the top of the 4th inning gave the Marlins the lead for good. Tyler Zuber earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out two in a scoreless inning.

In the American League, the Baltimore Orioles edged out the Detroit Tigers 10-9 in a back-and-forth affair. Spencer Torkelson hit his 5th home run of the season, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Orioles' offense. Tarik Skubal pitched well for the Tigers, striking out six in 6.2 innings.

On the West Coast, the San Francisco Giants routed the Milwaukee Brewers 16-3, behind a strong outing from Logan Webb. Daniel Susac hit two home runs and drove in four runs to lead the Giants' offense.
